15 / 3 = 5.0

Here, the parentheses are evaluated first, which results in the value 15. The division operator is

5
10 + (5 / 3) = 11

So, how does Python decide which operator to perform first? In this case,

15 / 3 = 5

If we want to perform these operations in one line, we can use the round function.
